text:
Jon: Quick check — can we carve a mini warm pool in eu-west1 (prefer uk-west2) for a private demo tomorrow 09:00-11:00 UTC? Need 4x A100 (2h). Who can greenlight?
Maya: Can you drop the PR for the infra change? also what's the SLO impact if we temporarily use reserved capacity?
Jon: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/812 — adds a transient warm-pool resource + autoscaler cap. small diff.
infra-bot: [deploy-bot] terraform plan completed for branch feat/warmpool-mini — no diffs to prod reserved pools, will create transient pool resource.
Deepa: Heads-up: tenant entitlements show only 2 free A100 slots in uk-west2 today. We may need a soft quota bump or borrow from demo standby.
Sam: I can try to allocate 4x A100 from demo-standby for the 2h window. Billing will attach to demo pool. If that fails, fallback plan: 2x H100 in eu-west3 + aggressive prefix cache warmup.
Maya: Please ping @oncall for manual approve if infra-bot flags quota issues. Also add a 1-paragraph runbook in the PR.
Jon: Runbook stub added to PR and I'll update ops/recipes/warmpool.md after merge. Cost estimate ~ $45/hr for the 4x A100 window.
Deepa: Approving contingent on CI passing and Sam confirming allocation ID.
Sam: Allocated standby slots tentatively, will post allocation ID by EOD. If vendor rejects, I'll notify and fallback to H100 plan. PR LGTM once tests pass.
Jon: Thanks — tagging into ticket #3456 and will update if anything changes. :thumbsup:
